items.title: Base change for an open immersion of schemes of finite type over a field, for torsion coefficients of invertible order
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves base change for an open immersion in the Kunneth setting: for K a field, j : U -> X an open immersion of K-schemes of finite type, Y of finite type over K and F an abelian sheaf on U_etale with torsion stalks of orders invertible in K, the base change map q^{-1}Rj_*F -> Rh_*p^{-1}F is an isomorphism (statement lines 20402-20417). The proof is a minimal-counterexample argument on dim(X) + dim(Y) with two nontrivial reductions: a point with positive transcendence degree over X is handled by a stalk computation at the strictly henselian local ring together with the vanishing of cohomology of torsion sheaves of invertible order on a curve (proof lines 20436-20484), and the symmetric situation over Y is excluded in the same way with the roles exchanged (proof lines 20487-20533); what remains is a point whose images are closed points, where the comparison is immediate (proof lines 20536-20549). The non-formal content is the combination of the two reductions with the dimension induction. The claim is H2: a long but completely written-out argument whose only external input is the vanishing statement for curves.
